rerunRules: Run only the selected finite cases. Reuse unchanged owner evidence on an explicitly compatible cut.
Preserve every original failure/interruption and assignment deadline; do not silently extend a running programme.
A changed implementation, schema, checker or runtime requires the affected proof again with its reason recorded.
After two failures inspect actual process, SQL waits/blocking PIDs, queue lease/fence and observation method before another run.
Operational limit exhaustion is incomplete evidence, never PASS or a narrowed acceptance contract.
No indefinite coding wait for protected trials, 90-day operation or 36-month follow-up.
